entities.name: Dragana Marinković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dragana Marinković is a Serbian professional volleyball player who competed for the Croatian and Serbian women's national teams in the 2000s. She is 1.97 m tall. Marinković has played for seven seasons in the Italian Serie A. In the season 2009/2010, she moved to Pesaro.
